deployments_detail.use: AI/data analytics for demand forecasting & supply chain decisioning across 4,050 SKUs/7,300 distributors/5M outlets; BHub app for real-time stock data (65-70% autonomous ops claim from weak source)

A-Eye, a multimodal AI voice shopping assistant that turns a smartphone camera into an in-store guide for visually impaired shoppers, reading out product names, pricing, ingredients, nutrition and expiry dates. Piloted at a MORE Supermarket in Bengaluru with ~4,000 visually impaired participants. [Google (Gemini, Vertex AI Multimodal Live / Project Astra); WPP (Mindshare, VML); MORE Retail]

Hyper-personalized AI-driven WhatsApp conversational experience for the Pure Magic Choco Stars launch: users shared name, birthdate and a selfie, which an AI mapped to zodiac signs to generate personalized videos, driving lead capture. Live campaign on WhatsApp. [Gupshup (conversational AI); Whilter.ai (video generation); AWS cloud]
deployments_detail.value: ~50,000 verified leads (3X target); 16 average messages per conversation

deployments_detail.use: 'Parvarish Ki Baat Papa Tripathi Ke Saath' rural AI IVRS campaign for Milk Bikis: a generative-AI voice clone of actor Pankaj Tripathi delivers personalized parenting advice in local UP dialects via a data-light interactive voice-response/conference system for feature-phone users without reliable internet. [mSamwaad (IVRS/audio conferencing); MullenLowe Lintas Group (creative); Mindshare India (media)]

BourbonIT Challenge 2.0, a multimodal, voice-first multilingual recipe assistant: consumers create Bourbon-biscuit recipes by voice, photo or link in seven Indian languages, with AI-generated recipes/images and an AI voice avatar of chef Pooja Dhingra. [Google Gemini (recipe/image generation); ElevenLabs (voice avatar); WPP Media; Digiiq (build)]

'Adengappa Kadhaigal 2.0', a Gen-AI storytelling platform for Milk Bikis: families in Tamil Nadu scan any Milk Bikis pack to generate personalized children's stories from everyday objects in English or Tamil, aimed at strengthening parent-child bonding. [Talented India (creative)]

Britannia 50-50 Golmaal 'BritannAI' campaign: an AI chatbot that generates personalized AI-powered video responses in the voice/likeness of cricket commentator Ravi Shastri, letting fans ask questions and receive witty video replies during the cricket season. [Mindshare India]

AI-powered mixed-reality smartphone camera campaign for NutriChoice: consumers scan a QR code on a print ad to trigger an AI-driven mixed-reality video experience featuring Ranveer Singh, described as India's first AI-powered MR smartphone camera experience. [none]

Inventory optimization and demand/supply planning solution: SKU segmentation, cycle/safety stock and reorder point methodologies, scenario building and a dynamic allocation system that continuously refreshes demand and supply data to maintain optimized inventory while holding service levels. [NTT DATA (Integrated Demand and Supply practice)]

Generative-AI workforce training and competency-assessment platform for factory officers: personalized learning paths, real-time assessments and manager-vs-employee gap analysis, delivered via factory-floor kiosks with multi-language support. Deployed to 431 officers across 3 departments in 18 of 23 facilities. [Edrevel]
deployments_detail.value: 75% time reduction (10 weeks to 20 days); Rs 200,000 cost savings; 288 productivity hours; 4X assessment frequency
